verdict.rationale: Intel documents official SDKs that target this processor family. oneAPI/oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations are stated as built "for Intel® Core™ Ultra processors (series 2)", and OpenVINO has a documented NPU device mode for Core Ultra NPUs. VTune adds profiling for client GPUs and NPUs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs on the 258V, in-depth API/reference documentation in the evidence, and explicit 258V-specific SDK coverage beyond the series-level claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Maximize AI PC inference capabilities from large language models (LLM) to image generation with Intel® oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) and PyTorch optimizations for Intel® Core™ Ultra processors (series 2) and Intel® Arc™ GPUs.
OpenVINO™ toolkit: An open source AI toolkit that makes it easier to write once, deploy anywhere.

The Neural Processing Unit is a low-power hardware solution, introduced with the Intel® Core™ Ultra generation of CPUs (formerly known as Meteor Lake). It enables you to offload certain neural network computation tasks from other devices
Optimize performance on client GPUs and NPUs from Intel with new analysis tool features in Intel® VTune™ Profiler.
